SparkR / SPARKR-217
master specified twice when submitting R job with sparkR-submit
Issue Type: Improvement
Assignee: Unassigned
Created: 03/Mar/15 11:14 PM
Priority: Minor
Reporter: Felix Cheung

When submitting a job with sparkR-submit

/usr/lib64/R/library/SparkR/sparkR-submit --master yarn-client examples/pi.R yarn-client 4

notice how the master is specified twice, once for spark-submit and once for sparkR.init (which is likely a no-op)

1. Should example or sparkR.init be changed or reordered to eliminate the duplication?
2. IMO, RRDD createSparkContext should detect that even when its master param is != "", master would have already been set (via spark-submit), if so it should ignore the param (I don't think it can change the master anyway at that point)

Re: master specified twice when submitting R job with sparkR-submit

Yeah, the right fix here is to update the example – The problem is that since we have two ways of submitting jobs right now (sparkR, sparkR-submit) and sparkR requires the master to be specified while sparkR-submit picks it up from the conf / command line arguments.

Going forward I think we can deprecate the sparkR script at some point and then clean up all the examples to not require the master url.
